## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Needs more work: the verifier could confirm only part of this procedure (the steps marked [Partial], or whether the list is complete). Steps or precautions may be wrong or missing; read the source thread before relying on it. Later runs fill it in as more sources are found.

1. Remove the right front inner fender liner to access the crankshaft sensor.
2. [Partial] Unplug the electrical connector on the cam sensors located at the rear of each cylinder head.

## Tips & gotchas

- [Partial] Use a light coating of dielectric grease on connectors and o-rings to seal moisture. [t96]
- Gently twist the harness plug if using an updated crank sensor with a metal sleeve and 180° clocked connector. [t96]
- Note that Bank 2 is left or Driver side. [t96]

## Common mistakes

- [Partial] Using cheap knockoff parts from auto stores without verifying fitment first. [t96]
- [Partial] Replacing sensors blindly without reading codes to confirm the specific failure point. [t96]
